title: Policies
description: Rotation, signal, action and breaker policies of namespace {{namespace}}
noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its policies.

kindDescriptions.rotation: How identities are selected, leased, reused and paired with proxies.
kindDescriptions.signal: Ordered rules that classify reports into outcomes and blame.
kindDescriptions.action: Cooldowns, bans, expiry and quarantine triggered by outcomes.
kindDescriptions.breaker: When an endpoint group trips open and how it recovers.

modeHints.shadow: Shadow mode: actions are only recorded as state events, nothing is applied.

revertModeHints.none: Cooldowns applied before the breaker opened stay in place.
revertModeHints.endpoint: When the breaker opens, identity × endpoint group cooldowns from risk outcomes in the window are reverted (bans are kept).
revertModeHints.all: When the breaker opens, all identity cooldowns from risk outcomes in the window are reverted (bans are kept).

list.label: Policies by kind
list.emptyDescription: Create a policy from a template to get started.

detail.selectDescription: Pick a policy on the left to edit it, compare versions, manage bindings or debug rules.
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted or belongs to another namespace.

editor.tooLarge: The YAML exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

builder.regenerateNotice: Form edits regenerate the YAML: comments and custom formatting are removed. Unset fields use the server defaults shown as placeholders.
builder.loadFailedTitle: This YAML cannot be edited in the form
builder.loadFailedDescription: It uses syntax or fields the form does not support. Edit it in YAML mode, or replace it with the template of this kind.
builder.nameReadOnly: The name cannot be changed after creation.
builder.extendsHint: Rules of the parent policy run first; the rules of this policy are appended.
builder.bindHint: Applied as a binding when the policy is created; manage bindings in the Bindings tab.
builder.identityTypesHint: Leave empty to use every identity type of the site and client.
builder.quotaHint: Requests per identity in this endpoint group per window (sliding window approximation).
builder.noQuota: No quota: identities are not limited per window.
builder.windowHint: Sliding window of reports used to evaluate the trip conditions.
builder.tripHint: Any satisfied condition opens the breaker; 0 disables a condition.
builder.openHint: The open duration doubles with every consecutive open, up to the maximum.
builder.halfOpenHint: While half-open, a few probe leases decide whether the breaker closes or opens again.

rules.nameHint: Optional; lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash.

nameErrors.pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-" (up to 64 characters).
nameErrors.duplicate: Another rule has the same name.
nameErrors.reserved: This name is reserved for built-in actions.

signal.rulesHint: Evaluated top-down; the first matching rule decides the outcome. Unmatched reports are unknown.
signal.noRules: No rules: every report is classified as unknown (or the trusted hint).
signal.trustOutcomeHintHint: Use the node's outcome hint when no rule matches and the hint is a known outcome.
signal.whenHint: All set conditions must match. Lists match when any value matches.
signal.blameHint: Overrides the default blame of the outcome.
signal.emptyRangeIgnored: An empty range is not written; set at least one bound.
signal.uriPrefixHint: Matches the request path, which must start with this prefix.
signal.uriRegexHint: RE2 syntax, matched against the request path.
signal.businessCodeHint: Business status codes extracted by the node.
signal.markersHint: Matches when the report carries any of these markers.

action.rulesHint: Every matching rule is evaluated; the most severe action per subject wins.
action.noRules: No rules: outcomes only update health scores.
action.scopeHint: Only scopes supported by the action are listed.
action.countHint: Match only when the subject had at least this many reports with the outcome in the window.
action.cooldownHint: Duration = min(base × multiplier^min(n − 1, max exponent), max), n = failure streak.
action.quarantineDurationHint: After the quarantine the identity becomes pending.
action.expireHint: Expire marks the identity as expired until its payload is updated.
action.escalationHint: Evaluated when a temporary ban is applied; the matching step with the highest threshold sets the duration.
action.healthHint: EWMA scores per identity and endpoint group, and the thresholds for automatic cooldown and quarantine.
action.observationsHint: Override the score an outcome contributes (defaults: success 100, empty 60, network_error 50, rate_limited 30, forbidden 10, captcha 0).
action.banExpiryHint: State of an identity when a temporary ban ends.
action.crossHint: Re-attributes risk outcomes to a proxy that fails with many identities, or confirms identity blame across proxies.

publish.title: Publish {{name}}?
publish.description: The draft is validated and published as version {{version}}. Bound endpoint groups use it within seconds.
publish.savesFirst: Unsaved changes are saved as the draft first.
publish.commentHint: Recorded with the version and in the audit log.

rollback.title: Roll back {{name}}?
rollback.description: The YAML of the selected version is published again as a new version (current: v{{current}}). The draft is not changed.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The policy, its draft and all versions are deleted permanently.
delete.bound_one: The policy is bound in {{count}} place. Remove the binding first.
delete.bound_other: The policy is bound in {{count}} places. Remove the bindings first.

create.title: New policy
create.description: The policy starts from the template of its kind; edit it afterwards in the form or YAML editor.
create.nameHint: Unique per kind; lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-".
create.nameInvalid: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-", starting with a letter or digit.
create.publishHint: Otherwise the policy is stored as a draft.

versions.emptyDescription: Publish the draft to create version 1.

bindings.bindDescription: Leave site, client and endpoint group empty for a namespace-wide binding. The most specific binding wins.
bindings.replaceHint: An existing {{kind}} binding at this level is replaced.
bindings.unpublishedWarning: This policy has no published version yet; publish it before binding.
bindings.noPermission: You need policy:publish on this scope to bind policies.
bindings.policyHint: Where this policy applies. Bindings you cannot read are not shown.
bindings.emptyPolicyDescription: Bind the policy to the namespace, a site, a client or an endpoint group to use it.
bindings.emptyUnpublished: Publish the policy, then bind it where it should apply.
bindings.emptyDescription: Nothing matches the filters; built-in defaults apply where nothing is bound.
bindings.removeDescription: {{policy}} is no longer the {{kind}} policy of {{target}}; the next less specific binding (or the built-in default) applies.

resolve.title: Effective policies
resolve.description: Shows which policy of each kind applies to a scope and the level of the winning binding.

debugger.targetHint: The report is evaluated with the policies resolved for this site, client and endpoint group. Nothing is applied.
debugger.targetRequired: Select a site, a client and, for this target, an endpoint group.
debugger.matchUriHint: Matched against the URI rules of the site and client.
debugger.useDraft: Use the draft of {{name}} instead of its published version
debugger.unsavedHint: The debugger uses the saved draft; save your editor changes first.
debugger.noDraftHint: The policy has no draft, so its published version is used.
debugger.reportHint: Facts a node reports after a request.
debugger.pasteDescription: Paste a report as JSON (as sent to ReportService, snake_case or camelCase). Only classification facts are used.
debugger.contextHint: Scores, samples and streaks of the identity, including this report.
debugger.cooldownRemainingHint: A running cooldown prevents a new low-score cooldown.
debugger.countsHint: Counter values including this report; missing counters count only this report.
debugger.banCountsHint: Bans of the identity per window, excluding the evaluated one (used by escalation).

errors.duration: Enter a finite duration such as 5m.

result.counters: Counters read by the action rules
result.noCounters: The action rules read no counters for this outcome.
result.counterDefault: Not set: counts only this report

toasts.rolledBack: Rolled back to v{{from}} as version {{version}}
